blocks.text: Toxicity (zehreelapan) yeh hai ke koi substance kisi jandaar (organism) ya environment (mahol) ko kis had tak nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. Material apni production (banne), use aur aakhri disposal (phenkne) ke waqt toxic ho sakta hai. Toxicity is se napi jati hai ke material kitna aur kis qism ka hazard (khatra) paida kar sakta hai. Hazards kai qism ke hain. Sab se pehle health hazards hain, yani substance ke saamne aane (exposure) se sehat ko nuqsan. Maslan chromium jaisi metals carcinogens (cancer paida karne wali), mutagens (DNA aur genes badalne wali) hain aur saans ki bimariyan (respiratory issues) deti hain. Aik aur misal plastics ke kuch additives (milaye gaye chemicals) hain jo jism mein hormones ki kharabi kar sakte hain.

Kuch materials apni physical ya chemical properties ki wajah se physical hazards paida karte hain. Yeh nuqsan imaraton, insanon, ecosystems aur environment ko ho sakta hai. Maslan aag pakarne wala (flammable) ya dhamake wala (explosive) material insanon aur jangalon ko nuqsan de sakta hai ya imarat ko tabah kar sakta hai. Environmental hazards woh substances paida karte hain jo pani ki zindagi (aquatic life) ya environment ko lambe arse tak nuqsan dete hain. Lead, mercury aur cadmium jaisi heavy metals mitti aur zameen ke neeche ke pani (groundwater) mein reas (leach) sakti hain. Heavy metals paudon, zameen par rehne wale janwaron, aur machhli aur doosre pani ke jandaron ke liye khatarnak hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khane: Health (chromium compounds), Physical (flammable, explosive) aur Environmental (mitti mein Pb, Hg, Cd).
blocks.caption: Khatron (hazards) ki teen qismein (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Health hazard aur environmental hazard mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Health hazard saamne aane par insan ki sehat ko nuqsan deta hai (maslan chromium se cancer). Environmental hazard pani ki zindagi ya environment ko lambe arse tak nuqsan deta hai (maslan heavy metals ka mitti aur groundwater mein reasna).

items: Toxicity: substance jandaron ya environment ko kis had tak nuqsan de sakta hai.
